office: the Passport Office, fees paid in postage stamps; abroad through an authorised mission

routes.label: standard, generally a month or more for a renewal

note: The fee table in the Passport form and instructions the Nevis Island Administration publishes (version of 2 August 2024): $250 standard and $350 expedited and urgent from 16 to 64, $150 and $250 under 16 and from 65, in Eastern Caribbean dollars paid in postage stamps; a live capture photo is $15 (whether it is always due is not said, so it isn't added). The Administration says renewals generally take a month or more. Applications from abroad pay in the local currency and are not modelled. Validity is a lead.

sources.title: Nevis Island Administration, St. Kitts and Nevis Passport form and instructions (v1, 2 August 2024)
sources.said: Regular - Standard (16 years – 64 years of age) $250 Regular - Standard (under 16 years of age) $150 Regular - Standard (65 years of age and above) $150 Regular - Expedited and Urgent (16 years – 64 years of age) $350 Regular - Expedited and Urgent (below 16 years of age) $250 Regular - Expedited and Urgent (65 years of age and above) $250

sources.title: Nevis Island Administration, Passport & Visa Services
sources.said: For a standard adult national, the cost is approximately $250 XCD. ... passport renewals generally require a month or more.
